title: Amazon reviews
description: Three row types share one dataset: review (one customer review, charged), product (the product's rating summary, charged) and status (per product, free).

dataset.title: Amazon reviews
dataset.description: Customer review rows and product rating-summary rows, plus status rows. Charged rows are billed as delivered; status rows are always free.

summary.title: Run summary
summary.description: One JSON record with the counts this run delivered and charged, its error and duplicate tallies, and its HTTP stats.
